purpose: Human-reviewable plan for the cinematic intro, consumed by Scripts/release_intro_sequence.py. Every coordinate below is traceable to a receipt under SourceAssets/ or to SourceAssets/architecture-manifest.json; nothing here is invented. The same numbers appear in Plugins/MikdashRuntime/Source/MikdashRuntime/Public/MikdashCinematics.h (IntroControlPoints) and in Plugins/MikdashRuntime/Tests/CameraPathMathTest.cpp, which proves the path clears the geometry.

worldFrame.note: Matches CameraPathMath.h exactly, so a rotator computed there can be keyed here without a sign fix-up.

levelHeights.source: SourceAssets/architecture-manifest.json, expectedBoundsUnrealCm of the named meshes

shots.beat: Establish the modern city. The camera holds high over the street beside the placed bus and begins to move, with the Kotel and the Mount already on frame.
shots.basis: TransitV2 bus actor origin [-37951.473, 46854.779]; capture view h in SourceAssets/visual-review/release-capture-20260908T023600Z/receipt.json places the eye at traced street level + 168, i.e. street level about 642.

shots.beat: Climb north-east across the Old City roofs.
Over the Kotel plaza, the wall passing under the camera.
shots.basis: kotel-detail manifest edge 0 west-facing face midpoint [-14788.765, 13872.183]; traced terrain there about -386 (capture views f and f2 of the same receipt).

shots.beat: Cross onto the Mount and reveal the enclosure whole.
shots.basis: Future Mount platform deck top Z 0 (capture view g). Both points are outside the outer court footprint, |Y| > 8100.

shots.beat: Come over the southern perimeter wall and descend across the outer court, the House turning through frame.
shots.basis: Outer perimeter wall top 3425 and outer court floor top 300, both from the architecture manifest. The wall is crossed at about Z 4125, well over the 3575 the 150 cm margin requires.

shots.beat: Turn onto the axis of the gates and level out for the run in.
shots.basis: Inner eastern vestibule floor, landings and stairs top 500 (Context 527 to 530, 657 to 659).

shots.beat: Through the inner eastern gateway on the axis and settle at the visitor's eye, facing the House. Control passes here.
shots.basis: Mikdash_PlayerStart [2100, 0], pawn centre Z 598, inner court clear floor top 500 plus 168 cm eye height (capture view b). The gateway is 500 cm wide between the jambs at |Y| >= 250 and runs from the threshold at 500 to the lintel soffit at 3000; the path crosses X = 2500 at about Y -4.5, Z 736.

easing.note: Velocity smoothsteps up, holds a genuinely constant speed through the middle, and smoothsteps down. No linear interpolation anywhere: the position track is an arc-length reparameterised centripetal Catmull-Rom and the keys are baked at 30 per second with cubic (auto) tangents.

clearance.bindingConstraint: The 168 cm eye height at the arrival point: a camera standing at eye height above a floor cannot clear that floor by more than 168 cm.
clearance.verifiedAgainst: All 2629 non-union meshes of SourceAssets/architecture-manifest.json, and separately against the 18 conservative blocking boxes listed in Plugins/MikdashRuntime/Tests/CameraPathMathTest.cpp.
clearance.hollowUnionNote: The manifest mesh 'Source solid union - outer envelope walls' has an AABB of [-8100,-8100,300]..[8100,8100,3425], which is the whole complex. It is a hollow Boolean union and is excluded from AABB clearance tests; the perimeter it represents is modelled as four 300 cm bands between the floor edge at 7800 and the platform edge at 8100.

orbits.basis: Menorah placed at [-5330, 315, 925], Heichal clear floor top 925.
Aron origin [-6200, 0, 925], keruvim mid-height 1063.5 (capture view e); Kodesh clear floor X -6700 to -5700.
Altar upper tier top 1067, wood 1091, yesod footprint 1600 square (manifest Context 64 to 70).
Outer court platform [-8100,-8100,0]..[8100,8100,299]. A full turntable, so it loops.

verification.compareRule: Every keyed location, rotation and field of view is read back out of the reopened Level Sequence and compared with the value the script computed, channel by channel.

limitations: Authoring only. Nothing here establishes visual acceptance, lighting acceptance, packaged playback, audio, or that the shot reads well; those need a human watching it.

Clearance is geometric, against axis-aligned boxes and against the map's own collision where a trace is available. It says nothing about foliage, decals, translucent volumes or anything without collision.
The Jerusalem context legs of the flight are checked against the map's collision at run time, not against the architecture manifest, because the city is not in that manifest.
